Best Migraine & Headaches Treatment in Ranchi

State-of-the-art neurology, comprehensive care, and advanced interventions by leading specialists.

Overview: Migraine & Headaches Treatment in Ranchi

While almost everyone experiences headaches, chronic migraines and cluster headaches can be exceptionally disabling, causing intense throbbing pain, often accompanied by severe nausea and sensitivity to light. Raj Hospital offers specialized migraine and headache treatment in Ranchi. Our neurologists evaluate root triggers and deploy advanced, multifaceted pain-relief protocols uniquely catered to your headache profile.

Common Symptoms of Migraine & Headaches

Recognizing symptoms early leads to better outcomes. Look out for:

  • Severe throbbing or pulsating pain, usually on one side of the head
  • Extreme sensitivity to light, sound, and sometimes smell/touch
  • Nausea and vomiting
  • Visual disturbances, such as seeing flashes of light or blind spots (Aura)

Advanced Diagnostic Technologies

Accurate diagnosis is crucial. We bring unparalleled precision to diagnosing neurological conditions using modern technologies.

  • Comprehensive Neurological Exam

    Detailed clinical mapping to rule out serious underlying causes like tumors or aneurysms.

  • MRI or CT Scans

    Recommended only if headaches are sudden, incredibly severe, or accompanied by neurological symptoms.

Our Treatment Approaches

Acute Pain-Relieving Medications

Triptans, anti-nausea drugs, and advanced painkillers designed to stop a migraine during an attack.

Preventive Medications

Beta-blockers, antidepressants, or anti-seizure drugs prescribed to reduce the frequency and severity of future attacks.

CGRP Antagonists

Newer, highly effective preventative treatments specifically targeting the migraine pathway.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about Migraine & Headaches treatments at Raj Hospital

What triggers a migraine?

Triggers vary hugely between patients but commonly include hormonal changes in women, specific foods, alcohol, immense stress, sensory stimuli (bright lights, strong smells), and changes in sleep patterns.

Can migraines be permanently cured?

Migraines cannot be permanently 'cured', but they can be remarkably well-managed. With strict identification of triggers and the right mix of preventive and abortive medications, attack frequencies can be vastly reduced.

What does a Migraine Aura distinctly feel like?

An aura involves visual disturbances like seeing bright flashing lights, zig-zag lines, or experiencing clear tingling sensations immediately before a massive severe headache hits.

Are tension headaches different from migraines?

Yes. Tension headaches present as a dull squeezing band around the head, usually without any nausea or light sensitivity associated with severe migraines.

Can botox be used for migraines?

Yes. For chronic migraines, targeted botox injections can precisely reduce pain pathways directly offering significant multi-month relief.
